# ThisIsTheWay.to

> Best practice guides for building a career in software development.

ThisIsTheWay.to is a collection of opinionated guides on various software and career development topics.

## Guides

- [Build with AI Agents](https://thisistheway.to/ai/llms.txt): Turning agent misses into systemic improvements
- [Practice Continuous Agentic Engineering](https://thisistheway.to/eng-loops): Keep a project moving across tasks and sessions
- [Guide text](https://thisistheway.to/eng-loops/llms.txt): Machine-readable overview and chapter links
- [Start with One Job](https://thisistheway.to/eng-loops/start): Let an agent research a goal, build a work list and deliver a checked result
- [Recover the Work](https://thisistheway.to/eng-loops/recovery): Save progress and recover after a lost chat or missed handoff
- [Put the Repository in Charge](https://thisistheway.to/eng-loops/repository): Design a controller that tracks jobs and enforces limits
- [Improve the Loop](https://thisistheway.to/eng-loops/improvement): Check the product on real workloads and learn from mistakes
- [Explore Another Approach](https://thisistheway.to/eng-loops/exploration): Compare two ways to solve a problem under the same budget
